content.page_title: Quality measures for heart failure care (excerpt)

Main (2) - ECG documentation.measure: Proportion of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings
Main (2) - ECG documentation.Numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their ECG findings.

Main (3) - NP measurement.measure: Proportion of patients with HF who have their NPs measured
Main (3) - NP measurement.Numerator: Number of patients with HF who have a documentation of their NPs levels.

Main (1) - Beta-blocker therapy.measure: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol in the absence of any contraindications
Main (1) - Beta-blocker therapy.Numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, or nebivolol.
Main (1) - Beta-blocker therapy.Denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for the beta-blocker bisoprolol, carvedilol, sustained-release metoprolol succinate, and nebivolol.

Main (2) - ACE inhibitor / ARB / ARNI th.measure: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI in the absence of any contraindications
Main (2) - ACE inhibitor / ARB / ARNI th.Numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed an ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI.
Main (2) - ACE inhibitor / ARB / ARNI th.Denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for ACE inhibitors, ARBs and ARNI.

Main (3) - Diuretic therapy for fluid re.measure: Proportion of patients with HF who are prescribed diuretic therapy if they have evidence of fluid retention
Main (3) - Diuretic therapy for fluid re.Numerator: Number of patients with HF, with evidence of fluid retention who are prescribed diuretic therapy.
Main (3) - Diuretic therapy for fluid re.Denominator: Number of patients with HF who have evidence of fluid retention and no contraindications for diuretic therapy.

Main (4) - MRA therapy.measure: Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed an MRA in the absence of any contraindications
Main (4) - MRA therapy.Numerator: Number of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed an MRA.
Main (4) - MRA therapy.Denominator: Number of patients with HFrEF without any contraindications for MRA.

Associated Conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)
Heart failure (general) - referenced in context of ACE inhibitors
genes.context: Referenced as 'ACE inhibitor' in the measure 'Proportion of patients with HFrEF who are prescribed ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI' with both numerator and denominator definitions mentioning ACE inhibitors.
